correctness.rationale: On xi<0, setting phi=1−exp(c xi) gives exact polynomial residual −(exp(c xi)−1)(2c²−kc−1)exp(c xi); choosing c=(k+sqrt(k²+8))/4 makes residual zero. On xi>=0 all terms vanish; phi continuous and phi phi′→0 at the interface, so no distributional Dirac mass. c>0 for every real k. Independent SymPy factorization confirmed this substitution and zero interface-flux limit. Correct existence but no stability/uniqueness/minimality is claimed.
